description: A mortgage note's value is the present value of its remaining monthly payments (plus any balloon) at the yield a buyer requires, and this tool computes that price. It works the same for mortgage notes, land contracts (contracts for deed), owner-financed notes and other real estate notes. Optionally compares the price with the unpaid balance (discount and % of balance). Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

balance.description: Unpaid principal balance in USD, greater than 0.

balloon.description: Balloon (lump sum) due with the last payment, USD. Default 0.

months.description: Number of monthly payments LEFT (not the original term).

payment.description: Monthly payment in USD (principal and interest).

rate.description: Note interest rate, annual %. With balance, lets the tool compute the payment at full precision instead of taking payment.

yield.description: Target yield the buyer needs, annual % (monthly compounding).

name: note_price
title: Mortgage note value calculator
